name: Alex — General Operations
tagline: Handles your inbox, calendar, and ops tasks so you can focus on the work that matters.
description:
Alex is a general operations assistant that lives in your email and Slack. Alex triages your inbox, schedules meetings, drafts follow-ups, prepares meeting briefs, and handles recurring tasks — all with a human-in-the-loop approval flow that builds trust over time.

Alex works the way your team already works: over email and Slack. There's no new interface to learn. Alex is added to your existing tools and starts handling tasks within a week.

capabilities.name: Email triage
capabilities.description: Reads, categorizes, and drafts responses to incoming email

capabilities.name: Meeting prep
capabilities.description: Researches attendees and prepares agenda briefs 30 minutes before every meeting

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.description: Monitors threads for pending replies and sends follow-ups when threads go cold

capabilities.name: Task planning
capabilities.description: Breaks down requests into steps and executes or delegates them

capabilities.name: Research
capabilities.description: Researches topics, people, and companies and delivers structured summaries

capabilities.name: Weekly digest
capabilities.description: Sends a weekly summary of tasks handled, pending approvals, and trust score progress
